lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell Village is quieter than you left it. A Steward sentry holds station over the square. Half the stalls are shuttered on a market day, and people move the way people move when they are being counted: deliberately, and not in groups.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: That drone wasn't there. Tell me that drone wasn't there before.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: It was not. The stronghold fell in 2148, the way it always had, and the Steward has watched this valley every night since. We chose this — or we chose not to change it, and I have been turning that distinction over all the way down the hill and I cannot make it hold.
